findings.title: `_DRIVE_QUALIFICATION_LINE_RE` is tested before the failure regex, so a candidate-controlled line beginning `RED-CASE:`/`GREEN-CASE:` leaves the failure denominator entirely — a narrow in-band bypass of this classifier's own "never trust a marker the child can forge" rule
`handoff.pin_check` now runs on every `orchid verify`, not only failed ones, with no timeout and no per-run opt-out; the shipped default builds a full release archive, so every pass pays it

the acceptance criteria's "harness fault" category ends up with no waiving arm — a timeout/SIGTERM-reaped verification charges an attempt, which is defensible under the spec's own uncertainty rule but means a `.orchid/`-owned verify timeout the implementer cannot fix still costs the budget
